organization.name: Zealynx Security
organization.summary: Security firm headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland, founded in 2024 by Carlos Vendrell, per its website. It sells smart contract audits, application security audits, AI red-teaming and MCP reviews, and runs Zealynx Academy with a Defence drill range. It also publishes Krait, an open-source AI auditing tool. The proposal says Zealynx owns the platform and excludes work TheDAO already funded.
